items.name: c-time-picker-1
items.title: Basic 24-hour time picker
items.description: Standard 2-column 24-hour time picker with now, clear, and confirm actions
items.descriptionLong: Basic 24-hour time picker. Built with the Time Picker component. A free, open source shadcn time picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-time-picker-1 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-time-picker-2
items.title: 12-hour time picker with seconds
items.description: 4-column 12-hour time picker with seconds and AM/PM selector
items.descriptionLong: 12-hour time picker with seconds. Built with the Time Picker component. A free, open source shadcn time picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-time-picker-2 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-time-picker-3
items.title: Stepped intervals and operating bounds
items.description: 15-minute stepped interval picker with min and max business hour constraints
items.descriptionLong: Stepped intervals and operating bounds. Built with the Time Picker component. A free, open source shadcn time picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-time-picker-3 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-time-picker-4
items.title: Composable raw time picker layout
items.description: Fully headless composable primitives with custom trigger and action layout
items.descriptionLong: Composable raw time picker layout. Built by composing Button, Time Picker. A free, open source shadcn time picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-time-picker-4 and edit as your own code.
